description: Five-layer deterministic framework with privileged measured verification; no learned predictor. Native In & Close only. Frozen official greedy H1 VLA, batch one; scoped language during bounded repair; no numeric action edits. Full-task prompt-refinement study focused on contain_release direction; no gate changes.

study.name: native_prompt_refine_20261021
study.primary: native full-task success for root4 and root0; regression checks on others
study.analysis: compare against prompt_only baseline; six reused development roots, no held-out or population claim
study.stopping: complete all thirty-six cells regardless of root4 outcome; no efficacy early stopping
study.recovery: retain all cases; exact replay; 30 baseline/variant full videos; publish and fresh remote recovery

wall_scope: scene setup + ten noops + rollout, excluding actor load
schedule: per root: baseline/v2, prompt_only/gate_only, combined; each wave then fresh replays; lanes alternate by root
invalid_policy: retain all cells; replay image mismatches remain failures
